title: Completed descent and finite projections of the strict scalar-limit map
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E,F$ finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, $i:E\to F$ a coefficient embedding, and $D$ a finite-field datum with $\ell\ne D.p$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated and of finite type between separated finite-type $D.k$-schemes, with compactification $c$. Fix reduction calculi $S,S'$ of [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data] and ramification data $e\ge1$ as in [lem-pur-compact-support-strict-scalar-mate]. On the source finite-Tor constructible integral category there exists an invertible natural completed-coefficient comparison $\gamma:C_Y P^c_E\to P^c_F C_X$. Under scalarCompletion and scalarSupportLimit of [def-pur-compact-support-scalar-limit-maps], its constant restriction is exactly scalarLimitArrow. For every source object and every $n\ge0$, the projection at exponent $e(n+1)$ of this specific strict limit arrow is the source projection tensored by finiteBalancing and followed by finiteTensorMap. After the specified completed coefficient transports, $\gamma$ composed with scalarSupportPositiveProjection and the image of scalarReductionBalancing is the finite scalar adjunction unit followed by restriction of scalarReductionBalancing, the scalar-extended source scalarSupportCounit, and finiteTensorMap. These are the three explicit equations in the Lean statement. This asserts no normalization, completeness or effectivity conclusion about the individual towers.

proof.text: Apply the single-field native effectivity theorem to the E tower and the full F tower, using preservation of the finite-Tor constructible domain under scalar extension. Use the quotient-normalized coefficient comparisons to identify complete objects and their constant restrictions.

The fixed tensor-limit isomorphism, actual strict scalar mate and inverse arithmetic restriction give scalarLimitArrow. On complete objects restriction to constants is an equivalence. Transport the arrow through scalarCompletion and scalarSupportLimit and lift uniquely; uniqueness gives naturality, and reflection of isomorphisms gives IsIso gamma.

Evaluate the retained projection: arithmetic restriction selects e(n+1)-1 and its block contribution vanishes; tensor interchange tensors coordinates. The evaluated strict mate and its finite balancing give the explicit constant projection equation.

Transport this projection equation to completed coefficients using the quotient-normalized scalarCompletion. Scalar adjunction units insert 1 and scalarReductionBalancing multiplies the last two scalars. Naturality gives exactly the displayed completed projection equation, with the actual source counit.

theorem scalarLimitCompletedComparison (c : Compactification f)
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E X)
    (S' : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l F X)
    (e : ℕ) (he : PurCompactSupport.Ramification l E F i e) (hepos : 1 ≤ e)
    : ∃ γ : (finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E X).ι ⋙ scalarSupport l E c S ⋙
        pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i Y) ⟶
      (finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E X).ι ⋙
        pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i X) ⋙ scalarSupport l F c S',
      IsIso γ ∧
      ∀ (M : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory l E X),
    ((baseTensor l E F i Y).map
          ((scalarSupportLimit l E c S).hom.app M.obj) ≫
          scalarLimitArrow l E F i c S S' e he hepos M.obj =
        (scalarCompletion l E F i Y).hom.app
            ((scalarSupport l E c S).obj M.obj) ≫
          (scalarConstantRestriction l F Y).map
            (γ.app M) ≫
          (scalarSupportLimit l F c S').hom.app
            ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i X)).obj M.obj)) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ,
      scalarLimitArrow l E F i c S S' e he hepos M.obj ≫
          (scalarLimitProjection l F Y (e * (n + 1) - 1)).app
            ((support l F c S').obj
              ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i X)).obj M.obj)) ≫
          (positiveSupportEvaluation l F c S' (e * (n + 1))
            (Nat.mul_pos hepos (Nat.le_add_left 1 n))).hom.app
              ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i X)).obj M.obj) ≫
          (positiveRestriction l F Y (e * (n + 1))
            (Nat.mul_pos hepos (Nat.le_add_left 1 n))).map
              ((PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.finite l F (e * (n + 1))
                (Nat.mul_pos hepos (Nat.le_add_left 1 n))) c).map
                  ((scalarReductionBalancing l E F i X e he hepos n).hom.app M.obj)) =
        (baseTensor l E F i Y).map
            ((scalarLimitProjection l E Y n).app ((support l E c S).obj M.obj) ≫
              (supportEvaluation l E c S n).hom.app M.obj) ≫
          (finiteBalancing l E F i Y e he hepos n).hom.app
            ((PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1)
              (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)) c).obj
                ((pbcDerivedExtend (PurCompactSupport.projection l E (n + 1)
                  (Nat.le_add_left 1 n) X)).obj M.obj)) ≫
          (positiveRestriction l F Y (e * (n + 1))
            (Nat.mul_pos hepos (Nat.le_add_left 1 n))).map
              (PurCompactSupport.finiteTensorMap l E F i e he hepos n c M.obj)) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ,
      γ.app M ≫
          scalarSupportPositiveProjection l F c S' (e * (n + 1))
            (Nat.mul_pos hepos (Nat.le_add_left 1 n))
            ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i X)).obj M.obj) ≫
          (pbcDerivedRestrict (PurCompactSupport.projection l F (e * (n + 1))
            (Nat.mul_pos hepos (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)) Y)).map
            ((PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.finite l F (e * (n + 1))
              (Nat.mul_pos hepos (Nat.le_add_left 1 n))) c).map
                ((scalarReductionBalancing l E F i X e he hepos n).hom.app M.obj)) =
        (pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (PurCompactSupport.projection l F (e * (n + 1))
          (Nat.mul_pos hepos (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)) Y)).unit.app _ ≫
          (pbcDerivedRestrict (PurCompactSupport.projection l F (e * (n + 1))
            (Nat.mul_pos hepos (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)) Y)).map
            ((scalarReductionBalancing l E F i Y e he hepos n).hom.app
                ((scalarSupport l E c S).obj M.obj) ≫
              (pbcDerivedExtend ((PurCompactSupport.finiteChange l E F i e he hepos (n + 1)
                (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)).map Y)).map (scalarSupportCounit l E c S n M.obj) ≫
              PurCompactSupport.finiteTensorMap l E F i e he hepos n c M.obj))
